items.requirement: The asset supports one coherent task or moment of need.
Steps and claims trace to current approved sources.
Only task-relevant context is included; exceptions and escalation are preserved.
Instructions use plain language, active voice, and one observable action per step where sequence matters.
Terminology matches approved sources and unavoidable terms are defined.
Semantic headings, lists, tables, links, language, reading order, and alternatives are verified in the final format.
Meaning does not rely on color, position, or images alone; contrast meets the approved target.
Filename, version, classification, taxonomy, owner, support, destination, and review trigger are recorded.
The final candidate was independently inspected and retrieved through the intended user path.
